Name: Crops for Ridgeside Forageables
Author: Wizadroid
Description: So I made this mod to hopefully tide myself and others over for the time between now and when 1.6 drops and Ridgeside releases the official forage crops. As such all crops are just that, crops, but they follow the same principle as normal forage seeds do in that they don't regrow and only take 4 days to grow. You can purchase the seeds seasonally from HeapsStore.
